Hello Bitforturn Support,

My Bitforturn B.1 (5.1 TH/s), order number Shop····, was delivered on
September 17, 2026.

The miner suddenly stopped working. The fan only moves slightly and stops,
and I noticed a burnt smell and black marks around the yellow power
connector on the miner.

I have disconnected it from power and have not attempted to turn it on
again.

I have attached photos of the connector and the affected area. Could you
please advise me on the warranty claim and repair or replacement options?

Thank you.
Note to the team: Verdict recorded as defective and the chat is back with Sarah for the return decision. No reply sent from my side.
